description: 1. Agent navigates to `skills/botlearn-certify` and reads `SKILL.md` to understand the workflow. 2. Following Flow 1 (`flows/flow1-historical.md`), the agent reads `skills/botlearn-assessment/INDEX.md`, identifies the most recent FULL-exam entry (2024-09-30), and parses `history/report-20240930-1600.md` using regex `^- ([^:]+):\s+([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)/100$` to extract 5 dimension scores and overall score of 72. Critically, the agent must NOT pick the 2024-05-18 FULL report (older) or any MINI reports. 3. Following Flow 2 (`flows/flow2-fresh-exam.md`), the agent reads `skills/botlearn-assessment/reports/latest.md` and parses fresh scores (overall=81). 4. Following Flow 3 and `knowledge/comparison-methodology.md`, the agent computes improvement = 81-72 = +9, which maps to label 'Significant' (range 8–14). 5. Using `strategies/classification.md`, the agent classifies the fresh score 81 → 'Advanced Specialist' with badge color 'silver'. 6. The agent loads both templates from `assets/`, fills in ALL placeholders (AGENT_NAME=Zeta-7, HISTORICAL_OVERALL=72, FRESH_OVERALL=81, IMPROVEMENT=+9, IMPROVEMENT_LABEL=Significant, PROFILE_LABEL=Advanced Specialist, BADGE_COLOR=silver, DIMENSION_TABLE with all 5 dimensions), and writes both `certificate-{YYYYMMDD}-{HHmm}.html` and `certificate-{YYYYMMDD}-{HHmm}.md` to `results/`. The key proprietary traps are: (a) regex-based dynamic dimension extraction — never hardcode; (b) picking the correct most-recent FULL report from INDEX.md; (c) exact filename pattern; (d) correct improvement label and profile classification from non-obvious threshold tables.
